newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia closes tender for stakes in 162 firms.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia closes tender for stakes in 162 firms.

text.p: The Slovenian Development Fund, the state's restructuring agency, said on Monday it had closed the tender for stakes in 162 companies worth a total 22.5 billion tolars ($170.5 million).
The fund said it expected all of the nation's 24 investment companies to have participated in the offer.
The tender was the first of its kind and replaced former auctions where shares of companies with poor business results often remained unsold.

In the tender, all firms are offered as one package, forcing investment companies to design a cartel agreement on how to divide the package. The tender was open to Slovenian investment companies only.
The Development Fund handles 20 percent of shares of all companies which have taken part in the country's privatisation process, which involves some 1,500 firms.
To date, 693 firms have been privatised, while another 566 are in the middle of the process.
